interpretation: On the frozen round-S3 lambda=1 background, the four scalar ell=1 conformal perturbations that annihilate the previously derived C12 block are exactly metric Lie derivatives generated by gradients of ell=1 harmonics. Therefore this residual kernel is a spatial-diffeomorphism gauge kernel in this scoped scalar/conformal block, not evidence for a physical loss of the second-class rank. This does not yet construct the complete HMT gauge-fixed Faddeev-Senjanovic determinant.
